services.name: Microblading
services.tagline: ✨Soft, natural, and expertly shaped — brows that stay put and turn heads.
services.longDescription: Define your shape and restore your confidence with soft, natural-looking hair strokes customized to your face. Perfect for sparse or uneven brows, microblading gives you fuller brows that look effortless every day.

landing.headline: Microblading That Elevates Your Natural Beauty

detail.intro: Microblading is a detailed, semi-permanent technique that uses fine, hair-like strokes to create naturally fuller brows. It’s perfect for clients who want subtle definition, improved shape, and long-lasting enhancement that looks soft and realistic.

sections.heading: What to Expect During Microblading
sections.body: Your artist begins by mapping your brows using precise measurements to ensure symmetry and balance. After selecting a pigment shade that matches your natural hair, fine strokes are implanted into the skin to replicate real brow hairs. The process is safe, meticulous, and customized to your features

sections.heading: Aftercare & Healing
sections.body: Proper aftercare helps your results heal beautifully. Avoid sweating, heavy workouts, and moisture on the brow area for the first few days. Mild fading, flaking, and darkening are normal during the healing process. A touch-up session enhances color and ensures long-lasting definition.

faqs.question: How long does microblading last?
faqs.answer: Typically 12–18 months, depending on skin type and aftercare.

faqs.question: What is PMU Removal?
faqs.answer: PMU (Permanent Makeup) removal is a non-invasive treatment that lifts and extracts unwanted pigment from the skin using a saline or non-laser technique.

faqs.question: How many sessions will I need?
faqs.answer: It varies depending on the depth, age, and color of the pigment. Most clients need between 2–5 sessions for optimal results.

faqs.question: Does PMU removal hurt?
faqs.answer: Most clients report only mild discomfort. We use a numbing agent to ensure your experience is as comfortable as possible.

faqs.question: What should I avoid before my appointment?
faqs.answer: Avoid blood thinners (like caffeine, aspirin, alcohol) 24 hours before your session. Come with no makeup on the treated area.

faqs.question: Can you remove old or botched microblading?
faqs.answer: Yes! We specialize in lifting and correcting old or poorly done brow tattoos, microblading, and other PMU services.

faqs.question: Is this better than laser removal?
faqs.answer: Our non-laser technique is gentler on the skin and specifically designed for delicate facial areas like brows, with less risk of scarring or color distortion.

landing.headline: Whiten Your Smile. Brighten Your Confidence.

detail.intro: Teeth whitening is a popular cosmetic procedure that uses bleaching agents to lighten the color of natural teeth and remove stains. The primary active ingredients are typically hydrogen peroxide or carbamide peroxide, which break down stain molecules in the enamel and dentin

sections.heading: Methods of Teeth Whitening
sections.body: This is the fastest and most effective method, performed by a dentist in a single or a few visits (e.g., Zoom whitening or laser whitening). The dentist applies a high-concentration peroxide gel (15% to 43%) and often uses a special light or heat to accelerate the process. This method provides immediate, dramatic results, often several shades lighter.

sections.heading: Important Considerations
sections.body: Before starting any whitening treatment, it is essential to have an oral examination to ensure your teeth and gums are healthy enough. Whitening is not suitable for individuals with gum disease, cavities, or exposed tooth roots.
